entities.summary: Curtis Kitchen is an American former professional basketball player. He was a 6-foot-9-inch (2.06 m), 235-pound (107 kg) power forward. Born in Cape Coral, Florida, he played collegiately at the University of South Florida for four seasons (1982–1986).
